title: History paging exposes an internal 500 when persistence disappears
outcome: get_session_history opens the SQLite history snapshot whenever the requested page or cursor is outside the resident window. If the persistence database path is absent or unavailable while TermAl is still running, that operational condition is converted to ApiError::internal and the route returns 500 with internal context. The adjacent missing-position path already returns a stable conflict instructing the client to refresh the tail. Define and use a clean public error contract for unavailable persisted history.
acceptance: A regression removes or makes the history store unavailable after an in-memory session exists and proves off-window history returns the chosen stable public error (for example conflict/retryable unavailable) without leaking internal persistence details. Resident history remains available, and frontend recovery behavior is deterministic.
